blocks.text: Banda warns Kahilur that the mountain chiefs will not remain secure forever, rejecting their confidence in forts, local siddhis, and inherited privilege.
The Kahilur side answers with pride, boasting of hidden powers and hill strength, and then begins writing outward to gather the Jalandhar hill rulers for a combined strike.
This page frames the next campaign as a hill-state coalition forming around Kahilur rather than a single local quarrel.
